target_customer: Home-services businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical) and enterprises needing AI call agents
problem: Missed and slow-handled inbound calls lose bookings; staffing call centers is expensive.
business_model: B2B usage/subscription voice agents, cloud and on-prem

founders.name: Derek Armfield
founders.background_notes: Childhood friend of Stefanov from Pittsburgh.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents assembled from speech and LLM APIs with CRM integrations such as ServiceTitan; reliability and latency are the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Many vendors offered similar voice agents in 2025 (Avoca, Thoughtly and others per 2025-26 pages); integrations are the main lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: ServiceTitan published an AI voice-agent guide for HVAC; no evidence of action against Acrely specifically.

market_need_then: Industry research cited by ServiceTitan claims home-service firms miss about 27% of inbound calls.

branding.domain_note: acrely.ai redirects (308) to lupitor.com as of Nov 2026.

identity.voice_and_tone: Lupitor site copy is direct and compliance-focused: Customer conversations, under your control.

rebrands.why: Unconfirmed; redirect suggests a rename or relaunch for regulated enterprises, timing not documented

brand_strength.rationale: Little coverage; the name was apparently dropped within about a year.

pivots.to: AI customer service for home-services businesses
pivots.why: Inbound interest from home-services firms; six customers in two weeks per a RuntimeWire piece

outcome_analysis: Acrely pivoted within its batch from real-estate scheduling to home-services call handling, then its domain began redirecting to Lupitor, an enterprise voice-and-chat agent platform that claims 40+ enterprise customers and a $5M raise. Sources do not establish that Lupitor is the same company, so the Inactive directory status may reflect a rename rather than a failure. Cause and date are not public.
notes: Directory says Inactive; the likely explanation is a rebrand to Lupitor (domain redirect), but no source confirms the corporate link. Lupitor's homepage $5M raise led by TQ Ventures is unverified and not recorded as a round. Aggregators list $500K and $1.11M totals (unverified). No competitor sources dated at the S25 batch were found; the 2025-26 vendor pages seen are marketing. Name origin not found. Completeness pass: the 2025-09 pre-seed of 500K rests on a single database (VCBacked); a search found no link between Acrely and TQ Ventures.
